source_description: Create and manage ElevenLabs voice agents from Claude.
project_fit_en: Dinev Assistant — rapid prototyping of the phone/voice-agent debrief flow for installers.
project_fit_bg: Dinev Assistant — бързо прототипиране на телефонния/voice-agent поток за дебриф на монтажниците.
build_vs_buy_en: High leverage: test an existing voice-agent control surface before building our own orchestration around calls.
build_vs_buy_bg: Висок лост: тестваме готов интерфейс за voice agents, преди да строим собствена оркестрация около разговорите.
why_it_matters_en: It directly overlaps the planned service-number → recorded call → structured handover workflow and could shorten the experiment cycle.
why_it_matters_bg: Попада директно върху планирания поток служебен номер → записан разговор → структурирано предаване и може да скъси цикъла на експериментиране.
cheapest_test_en: Spend 30 minutes recreating one installer debrief voice-agent flow; do not integrate production systems.
cheapest_test_bg: 30-минутен тест: пресъздай един installer debrief voice-agent поток, без production интеграция.
risk_overlap_en: Do not let it replace the durable Dinev Assistant data model or evidence trail; evaluate it only as a voice execution layer.
risk_overlap_bg: Да не заменя устойчивия data model и evidence trail на Dinev Assistant; оценяваме го само като voice execution layer.

source_description: A decision journal focused on calibration.
project_fit_en: Claim Ledger / Outcome / Calibration — competitive archaeology for decision logging and calibration UX.
project_fit_bg: Claim Ledger / Outcome / Calibration — competitive archaeology за decision logging и calibration UX.
build_vs_buy_en: Use it to learn what can be simpler in our own decision→outcome→calibration loop, not as a replacement for the canonical ledgers.
build_vs_buy_bg: Използваме го, за да видим какво може да е по-просто в нашия decision→outcome→calibration loop, не като заместител на canonical ledgers.
why_it_matters_en: It attacks a neighboring problem with a much smaller consumer UX and may expose unnecessary ceremony in our architecture.
why_it_matters_bg: Решава съседен проблем с много по-малък consumer UX и може да покаже излишна церемония в нашата архитектура.
cheapest_test_en: Inspect its decision entry, prediction, outcome and calibration flow for 30 minutes; record only concrete UX/mechanism differences.
cheapest_test_bg: 30 минути: разгледай decision entry, prediction, outcome и calibration потока и запиши само конкретните UX/механизъм разлики.
risk_overlap_en: Do not migrate Claim Ledger or Trust Engine; this is a design comparison only.
risk_overlap_bg: Без миграция на Claim Ledger или Trust Engine; това е само design comparison.

source_description: AI agents that QA a website before launch.
project_fit_en: Discovery Machine Mobile Console — independent UI regression and launch QA.
project_fit_bg: Discovery Machine Mobile Console — независим UI regression и launch QA.
build_vs_buy_en: Potentially high: buy/test a specialized QA layer instead of building another internal QA agent.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциално висок: тестваме специализиран QA слой вместо да строим още един вътрешен QA agent.
why_it_matters_en: The console already had a real loading-loop regression; an external QA layer can test what our own implementation may miss.
why_it_matters_bg: Console вече имаше реален loading-loop regression; външен QA слой може да хване пропуски на собствената ни имплементация.
cheapest_test_en: Run one Mobile Console regression pass against the live Pages site and compare findings with the current Playwright checks.
cheapest_test_bg: Пусни един regression pass върху live Mobile Console и сравни находките с текущите Playwright проверки.
risk_overlap_en: Avoid duplicating existing deterministic tests unless it finds failures they do not catch.
risk_overlap_bg: Да не дублираме съществуващите deterministic tests, освен ако намира проблеми, които те не хващат.
verdict_en: Cheap test on the live console.

source_description: A persistent terminal for Codex and Claude side by side.
project_fit_en: Multi-model coding workflow — possible operational workbench for Claude and Codex while Git remains the durable handoff layer.
project_fit_bg: Multi-model coding workflow — възможна оперативна работна маса за Claude и Codex, докато Git остава устойчивият handoff layer.
build_vs_buy_en: Could reduce context switching without changing the repository architecture.
build_vs_buy_bg: Може да намали прескачането между инструменти, без да променя repository архитектурата.
why_it_matters_en: The current workflow already uses multiple coding agents; a persistent side-by-side terminal may remove friction if it preserves blind/durable Git boundaries.
why_it_matters_bg: Текущият workflow вече използва няколко coding agents; persistent side-by-side terminal може да намали триенето, ако пази blind/durable Git границите.
cheapest_test_en: Use it for one small isolated coding task; verify whether model outputs remain separated and Git stays the only durable shared state.
cheapest_test_bg: Използвай го за една малка изолирана coding задача; провери дали model outputs остават разделени и Git остава единственото устойчиво shared state.
risk_overlap_en: Shared terminal context could weaken model blindness or create an informal second source of truth.
risk_overlap_bg: Shared terminal context може да отслаби model blindness или да създаде неформален втори source of truth.

source_description: Search local video by dialogue, speakers, scenes and visual context and expose clips to AI tools.
project_fit_en: Dinev Assistant v2 — searchable memory over site videos and installer walkthroughs.
project_fit_bg: Dinev Assistant v2 — търсима памет върху видеата от обекти и installer walkthroughs.
build_vs_buy_en: Potential future buy/reuse instead of building video indexing from scratch.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциално бъдещо buy/reuse вместо да строим video indexing от нулата.
why_it_matters_en: It maps closely to the principle that the site should carry its own memory, but video analysis is intentionally outside the current MVP.
why_it_matters_bg: Съвпада силно с принципа обектът да носи собствената си памет, но video analysis умишлено е извън текущия MVP.
cheapest_test_en: No test now; revisit when Dinev Assistant reaches the video-analysis stage.
cheapest_test_bg: Без тест сега; върни се към него, когато Dinev Assistant стигне до video-analysis етап.
risk_overlap_en: Testing now would expand MVP scope and distract from the call/debrief core.
risk_overlap_bg: Тест сега би разширил MVP scope и би отвлякъл фокуса от call/debrief ядрото.

source_description: Turn spoken feedback into tasks your coding agent can run.
project_fit_en: Dinev Assistant and AI coding workflows — convert a spoken walkthrough into structured, executable tasks while preserving the original evidence separately.
project_fit_bg: Dinev Assistant и AI coding workflows — превръща устен walkthrough в структурирани изпълними задачи, като оригиналното evidence остава отделно.
build_vs_buy_en: High leverage if it can perform the speech-to-structured-task step without us building another interpretation layer.
build_vs_buy_bg: Висок лост, ако може да изпълни speech-to-structured-task стъпката без да строим още един interpretation layer.
why_it_matters_en: Its core mechanism closely matches the installer debrief problem: people describe issues naturally, change their mind mid-sentence, and the system must resolve that into actionable tasks.
why_it_matters_bg: Основният му механизъм силно прилича на installer debrief проблема: хората описват естествено, променят мисълта си по средата и системата трябва да превърне това в изпълними задачи.
cheapest_test_en: Use one non-sensitive recorded walkthrough or live mock debrief and compare its task extraction with the current Dinev Assistant handover fields; stop if provenance is lost.
cheapest_test_bg: Пусни един несекретен записан walkthrough или mock debrief и сравни извлечените задачи с текущите Dinev Assistant handover полета; прекрати теста, ако provenance се губи.
risk_overlap_en: It targets coding-agent tasks, not furniture-site handovers; do not assume domain transfer, and do not let generated tasks replace raw evidence/transcript.
risk_overlap_bg: Насочен е към задачи за coding agents, не към мебельни обекти; не приемаме автоматично domain transfer и генерираните задачи не трябва да заменят raw evidence/transcript.

source_description: Weird, playful desktop app for building with AI agents.
project_fit_en: AOC / AI Operations Center — competitive archaeology for a local visual workspace where agents, files, skills and session history coexist without replacing Git as durable project memory.
project_fit_bg: AOC / AI Operations Center — competitive archaeology за локално визуално работно пространство, в което agents, файлове, skills и session history съжителстват, без да заменят Git като устойчива проектна памет.
build_vs_buy_en: Potential design leverage: learn from an existing agent-workspace interaction model instead of inventing the entire operator UX from scratch.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциален design leverage: учим от готов interaction model за agent workspace, вместо да измисляме целия operator UX от нулата.
why_it_matters_en: It is adjacent to the AOC vision of a human supervising many agents, but its local-first canvas and on-machine history may reveal simpler operator primitives than a full platform architecture.
why_it_matters_bg: Близо е до AOC визията човек да управлява много agents, а local-first canvas и on-machine history могат да покажат по-прости operator primitives от цяла платформа.
cheapest_test_en: Inspect the public demo/docs for 30 minutes and record only three things: agent/session identity, durable-state boundary, and how a human sees parallel work. No install or migration required.
cheapest_test_bg: 30 минути преглед на public demo/docs и запиши само три неща: agent/session identity, durable-state boundary и как човек вижда паралелната работа. Без инсталация или миграция.
risk_overlap_en: Strong overlap with AOC concepts; using it as a platform could create a second source of truth or conflict with Git-based lifecycle discipline.
risk_overlap_bg: Силен overlap с AOC концепциите; използването му като платформа може да създаде втори source of truth или конфликт с Git-based lifecycle дисциплината.

source_description: Run AI models on any device.
project_fit_en: Dinev Assistant future edge/offline execution — possible local transcription/inference layer where API cost, connectivity or data locality later become constraints.
project_fit_bg: Dinev Assistant бъдещо edge/offline изпълнение — възможен локален transcription/inference layer, ако API разходът, свързаността или data locality по-късно станат ограничения.
build_vs_buy_en: Potential future buy/reuse rather than building local inference plumbing, but not justified for the current cloud-STT MVP.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциално бъдещо buy/reuse вместо да строим local inference plumbing, но не е оправдано за текущия cloud-STT MVP.
why_it_matters_en: The constrained-output mechanism built from function signatures is especially relevant to reliable structured extraction from small local models, but Bulgarian quality and device performance are unverified.
why_it_matters_bg: Механизмът за constrained output от function signatures е особено релевантен за надеждно структурирано извличане от малки локални модели, но качеството на български и производителността по устройства не са проверени.
cheapest_test_en: No integration now; when edge inference becomes relevant, test one Bulgarian installer transcript against the same JSON schema used by the cloud baseline.
cheapest_test_bg: Без интеграция сега; когато edge inference стане релевантен, тествай един български installer transcript срещу същата JSON schema като cloud baseline.
risk_overlap_en: Premature testing would expand MVP scope; the newsletter does not establish Bulgarian STT quality, latency or hardware requirements.
risk_overlap_bg: Преждевременен тест би разширил MVP scope; newsletter-ът не доказва качество на български STT, latency или хардуерни изисквания.
verdict_en: Watch; revisit only when edge constraints become real.
verdict_bg: WATCH; върни се към него само когато edge constraints станат реални.

source_description: Run AI agents on your Mac with scoped access.
project_fit_en: AOC / agent-execution safety — competitive archaeology for scoped machine access, credential boundaries, and a second-model gate in front of agent actions.
project_fit_bg: AOC / безопасност при изпълнение на агенти — competitive archaeology за ограничен достъп до машината, граници около credentials и second-model gate пред действията на агента.
build_vs_buy_en: Potential architecture leverage: inspect an existing scoped-access pattern instead of inventing machine-permission mediation from scratch; do not replace Git or current execution provenance.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциален архитектурен лост: разглеждаме готов scoped-access pattern вместо да измисляме machine-permission mediation от нулата; без замяна на Git или текущото execution provenance.
why_it_matters_en: The active AOC direction increasingly supervises long-running agents, so capability boundaries around browser, shell and credentials may matter more than adding another agent surface.
why_it_matters_bg: Активната AOC посока все повече наблюдава long-running agents, затова границите около browser, shell и credentials могат да са по-важни от добавянето на още един agent surface.
cheapest_test_en: Spend 30 minutes reviewing the public permission model and failure boundaries; do not install it or expose real credentials.
cheapest_test_bg: 30 минути преглед на публичния permission model и failure boundaries; без инсталация и без реални credentials.
risk_overlap_en: A second-model permission gate can create false confidence and an extra decision layer; the newsletter demo is not evidence of robust security.
risk_overlap_bg: Second-model permission gate може да създаде фалшива увереност и допълнителен decision layer; newsletter demo-то не е доказателство за надеждна сигурност.
verdict_en: Inspect the mechanism only; no install.

source_description: One endpoint across major models that routes to the cheapest option meeting a quality bar and maps spend to teams and budgets.
project_fit_en: AOC Model Gateway / Discovery Lab resource-control research — competitive archaeology for quality-constrained model routing, team-level token budgets, and spend attribution.
project_fit_bg: AOC Model Gateway / Discovery Lab resource-control research — competitive archaeology за model routing с quality constraint, team-level token budgets и attribution на разхода.
build_vs_buy_en: High design leverage if its budget and routing primitives are simpler than our own control-plane ideas; it should not replace the existing provider registry or canonical ledgers.
build_vs_buy_bg: Висок design leverage, ако budget и routing primitives са по-прости от нашите control-plane идеи; не трябва да заменя съществуващия provider registry или canonical ledgers.
why_it_matters_en: It independently productizes the same emerging problem seen in our VALIDATING resource/spend candidates: agentic model consumption needs pre-action routing and budget control, not only post-hoc billing.
why_it_matters_bg: Независимо продуктово материализира същия зараждащ се проблем, видян в нашите VALIDATING resource/spend кандидати: agentic model consumption се нуждае от pre-action routing и budget control, не само post-hoc billing.
cheapest_test_en: Inspect the public routing, budget and attribution model for 30 minutes and compare only the control primitives with AOC Model Gateway and BC-0039/BC-0130; no traffic migration.
cheapest_test_bg: 30 минути преглед на routing, budget и attribution модела и сравнение само на control primitives с AOC Model Gateway и BC-0039/BC-0130; без миграция на трафик.
risk_overlap_en: Strong overlap with the existing AOC model-routing layer; vendor savings claims are not treated as evidence and must not promote BCA candidates.
risk_overlap_bg: Силен overlap със съществуващия AOC model-routing layer; vendor savings claims не са evidence и не трябва да промотират BCA кандидати.

source_description: Vercel's tiny open-source coding agent, written in Zig, with local or cloud model support and a Unix-tool style interface.
project_fit_en: AOC / coding-agent workflow — competitive archaeology for a deliberately minimal agent harness and lower context/runtime overhead.
project_fit_bg: AOC / coding-agent workflow — competitive archaeology за нарочно минимален agent harness и по-нисък context/runtime overhead.
build_vs_buy_en: Useful as a minimal-harness reference, not as a new platform: compare what can be removed from our workflows before adding more orchestration.
build_vs_buy_bg: Полезен като reference за minimal harness, не като нова платформа: сравняваме какво може да се премахне от нашите workflows, преди да добавяме още orchestration.
why_it_matters_en: Our ecosystem risk is increasingly orchestration complexity; a small Unix-style agent is a useful counterexample to the assumption that more agent infrastructure is always better.
why_it_matters_bg: Рискът в екосистемата ни все повече е orchestration complexity; малък Unix-style agent е полезен контрапример на допускането, че повече agent infrastructure винаги е по-добре.
cheapest_test_en: Read the public repository architecture for 30 minutes and note which capabilities are intentionally absent; no installation required.
cheapest_test_bg: 30 минути преглед на публичната repository архитектура и отбелязване кои capabilities умишлено липсват; без инсталация.
risk_overlap_en: It overlaps existing Claude/Codex coding workflows and does not justify another permanent executor.
risk_overlap_bg: Дублира съществуващите Claude/Codex coding workflows и не оправдава още един permanent executor.

source_description: Free local transcription that is 100% Private.
project_fit_en: Dinev Assistant STT spike — a local/private transcription candidate for installer calls or debrief recordings.
project_fit_bg: Dinev Assistant STT spike — local/private transcription кандидат за разговори или debrief записи на монтажниците.
build_vs_buy_en: Potentially high if Bulgarian transcription quality is acceptable, because it could provide a local privacy-preserving baseline without building STT infrastructure.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциално висок, ако качеството на българската транскрипция е приемливо, защото може да даде local privacy-preserving baseline без да строим STT инфраструктура.
why_it_matters_en: Dinev Assistant already needs real Bulgarian STT comparison across noisy field recordings; a local option adds a useful privacy/offline axis to that experiment.
why_it_matters_bg: Dinev Assistant вече има нужда от реално сравнение на български STT върху шумни field recordings; local вариантът добавя полезна privacy/offline ос към експеримента.
cheapest_test_en: Run one non-sensitive Bulgarian installer recording and compare transcript usability against the existing cloud STT baseline; stop if Bulgarian quality is poor.
cheapest_test_bg: Пусни един несекретен български installer запис и сравни usability на транскрипта с текущия cloud STT baseline; прекрати, ако качеството на български е слабо.
risk_overlap_en: The newsletter does not establish Bulgarian-language quality, diarization, or noisy-site performance; do not expand the MVP if it fails the one-recording test.
risk_overlap_bg: Newsletter-ът не доказва качество на български, diarization или работа при шумен обект; не разширявай MVP, ако се провали на един запис.

source_description: All your data in Claude and Codex.
project_fit_en: AOC / Project Memory — competitive archaeology for making heterogeneous project data accessible to coding agents without replacing Git as durable truth.
project_fit_bg: AOC / Project Memory — competitive archaeology за достъп на coding agents до разнородни проектни данни, без да заменя Git като устойчива истина.
build_vs_buy_en: Potential design leverage around context aggregation and agent access, but our connected-source and Git-memory layers already cover part of this problem.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциален design leverage около context aggregation и agent access, но connected-source и Git-memory слоевете ни вече покриват част от проблема.
why_it_matters_en: The useful question is whether it exposes a simpler data-access primitive than our current project-memory and connector stack, not whether we should migrate data into another platform.
why_it_matters_bg: Полезният въпрос е дали предлага по-прост data-access primitive от текущия Project Memory/connector stack, а не дали да местим данни в друга платформа.
cheapest_test_en: Inspect the public data-source, permission and provenance model for 30 minutes; stop if it cannot preserve source identity or would become a second source of truth.
cheapest_test_bg: 30 минути преглед на data-source, permission и provenance модела; стоп, ако не пази source identity или би станал втори source of truth.
risk_overlap_en: Strong overlap with existing connectors, Project Memory and Git-backed context; no migration and no permanent integration from this signal alone.
risk_overlap_bg: Силен overlap със съществуващите connectors, Project Memory и Git-backed context; без миграция и без постоянна интеграция само от този сигнал.

source_description: Extract data from anywhere on the web within minutes.
project_fit_en: Discovery Lab source acquisition — possible external extraction layer for difficult web sources before building another source-specific adapter.
project_fit_bg: Discovery Lab source acquisition — възможен външен extraction layer за трудни web източници, преди да строим още един source-specific adapter.
build_vs_buy_en: Potentially high only for source types the current collectors cannot reliably parse; otherwise it would duplicate the existing sensor stack.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциално висок само за source types, които текущите collectors не могат надеждно да parse-нат; иначе ще дублира съществуващия sensor stack.
why_it_matters_en: A bounded extraction service could save adapter-building time if it succeeds on one currently troublesome public source while preserving raw-source provenance.
why_it_matters_bg: Ограничена extraction услуга може да спести време за adapter-и, ако успее върху един текущо труден публичен източник и запази raw-source provenance.
cheapest_test_en: Give it one public source that currently causes extraction friction and compare completeness, provenance and reproducibility with the existing collector; no pipeline integration.
cheapest_test_bg: Дай му един публичен източник, който сега създава extraction friction, и сравни completeness, provenance и reproducibility с текущия collector; без pipeline интеграция.
risk_overlap_en: Could create an opaque derived layer or duplicate the Sensor Agent; reject if raw evidence and deterministic replay are not available.
risk_overlap_bg: Може да създаде непрозрачен derived layer или да дублира Sensor Agent; отхвърли, ако няма raw evidence и deterministic replay.

source_subject: 😸 A dive computer for the bath
project_fit_en: Discovery Lab / AOC and Mobile Console quality assurance — a bounded external check for end-to-end UI regressions as coding-agent output grows.
project_fit_bg: Discovery Lab / AOC и качеството на Mobile Console — ограничена външна проверка за end-to-end UI регресии при нарастващ coding-agent output.
build_vs_buy_en: Potential leverage if it can generate portable Playwright tests faster than maintaining another internal QA layer, but the repository already has regression tests and review gates.
build_vs_buy_bg: Потенциален лост, ако генерира преносими Playwright тестове по-бързо от поддръжката на още един вътрешен QA слой, но repository-то вече има regression tests и review gates.
why_it_matters_en: The Mobile Console has already suffered a real loading-loop regression, so an independently produced browser test could reveal whether current tests are shaped too closely by the implementation.
why_it_matters_bg: Mobile Console вече претърпя реална loading-loop регресия, затова независимо произведен browser test може да покаже дали текущите тестове са прекалено близо до имплементацията.
cheapest_test_en: In no more than 30 minutes, run one non-destructive public Mobile Console flow and compare the finding with the current Playwright coverage; give the service no repository write access.
cheapest_test_bg: За не повече от 30 минути пусни един неразрушителен публичен Mobile Console flow и сравни находката с текущото Playwright покритие; без write достъп до repository-то.
risk_overlap_en: Strong overlap with existing Playwright and adversarial-review layers; auto-healing could hide a real behavior change, and vendor claims are not independent evidence.
risk_overlap_bg: Силен overlap със съществуващите Playwright и adversarial-review слоеве; auto-healing може да скрие реална промяна в поведението, а vendor твърденията не са независимо доказателство.
verdict_en: One-flow kill test only; no integration.
verdict_bg: Kill test с един flow; без интеграция.

source_subject: 😸 A dive computer for the bath
project_fit_en: Discovery Lab multi-provider evaluation / future X Signal Probe — a possible later third-provider control for long-running agent and coding analysis.
project_fit_bg: Discovery Lab multi-provider evaluation / бъдещ X Signal Probe — възможна по-късна third-provider контрола за long-running agent и coding анализ.
build_vs_buy_en: It could provide a ready external model instead of building another evaluator, but adding a third provider is not justified while the same-mechanism gate and current validation path remain unresolved.
build_vs_buy_bg: Може да даде готов външен модел вместо изграждане на още един evaluator, но добавянето на трети provider не е оправдано, докато same-mechanism gate-ът и текущият validation path остават нерешени.
why_it_matters_en: Its positioning around long-running agents is relevant to the project's execution model, but a product launch and vendor benchmarks do not establish independent decision quality on our evidence packets.
why_it_matters_bg: Позиционирането му около long-running agents е релевантно за execution модела на проекта, но product launch и vendor benchmarks не доказват независимо качество на решенията върху нашите evidence packets.
cheapest_test_en: Do not integrate now; after the gate correction, run one frozen evidence packet through the identical prompt and schema and compare provenance, failure behavior and cost.
cheapest_test_bg: Без интеграция сега; след корекцията на gate-а пусни един frozen evidence packet през идентични prompt и schema и сравни provenance, failure behavior и разход.
risk_overlap_en: It overlaps the existing Claude plus OpenAI path and would add orchestration and attribution complexity; model verdicts must remain analytical signals, not primary evidence.
risk_overlap_bg: Припокрива се със съществуващия Claude плюс OpenAI path и би добавил orchestration и attribution сложност; model verdict-ите трябва да останат аналитични сигнали, не първично доказателство.
verdict_en: Watch; test only after the current gate correction.
verdict_bg: WATCH; тествай само след текущата корекция на gate-а.

source_description: Every local project gets a real address.
project_fit_en: Mobile Console and web-project QA — real-device review of a local build before deployment.
project_fit_bg: Mobile Console и QA на web проекти — преглед на локален build от реално устройство преди deployment.
build_vs_buy_en: It may remove tunnel and certificate setup for local mobile testing, but existing preview and deployed flows already cover much of this need.
build_vs_buy_bg: Може да премахне настройката на tunnel и сертификат за локални mobile тестове, но съществуващите preview и deployed потоци вече покриват голяма част от нуждата.
why_it_matters_en: A real phone can expose layout, authentication and device-specific failures before deployment; value exists only when the current preview cannot expose the local build.
why_it_matters_bg: Реален телефон може да покаже layout, authentication и device-specific дефекти преди deployment; стойност има само ако текущият preview не може да покаже локалния build.
cheapest_test_en: Expose one non-sensitive local Mobile Console page to a phone for 15 minutes, with no production data or credentials.
cheapest_test_bg: Покажи една несекретна локална Mobile Console страница на телефон за 15 минути, без production данни или credentials.
risk_overlap_en: It exposes a local service and strongly overlaps existing preview/deployment paths; reject it if access controls are unclear or the current preview is sufficient.
risk_overlap_bg: Излага локална услуга и силно се припокрива със съществуващите preview/deployment пътища; отхвърли го, ако access controls са неясни или текущият preview е достатъчен.
verdict_en: One-device kill test; no permanent dependency.
verdict_bg: Kill test на едно устройство; без постоянна зависимост.

source_description: Update your dependencies and undo anything.
project_fit_en: AOC and repository-maintenance safety — a reference pattern for reversible dependency changes.
project_fit_bg: AOC и безопасност при repository maintenance — референтен pattern за обратими dependency промени.
build_vs_buy_en: The leverage is in learning its invariants — dirty-worktree refusal, exact file snapshots, byte-for-byte rollback and script-disabled audits — rather than adopting another updater.
build_vs_buy_bg: Лостът е в изучаването на инвариантите — отказ при dirty worktree, точни file snapshots, byte-for-byte rollback и audit с изключени scripts — а не в приемането на още един updater.
why_it_matters_en: Those invariants are directly relevant to safe agent-driven repository maintenance and recovery.
why_it_matters_bg: Тези инварианти са директно релевантни за безопасна agent-driven repository maintenance и recovery.
cheapest_test_en: Spend 30 minutes comparing the four invariants with the current maintenance workflow; do not install it or update dependencies.
cheapest_test_bg: За 30 минути сравни четирите инварианта с текущия maintenance workflow; без инсталация и без dependency updates.
risk_overlap_en: It is Mac/npm-specific, Git already provides rollback primitives, and it is not a substitute for tests or supply-chain analysis.
risk_overlap_bg: Специфичен е за Mac/npm, Git вече дава rollback primitives и не е заместител на тестове или supply-chain анализ.
verdict_en: Inspect the safety pattern; no installation.

source_description: The MCP that proves your AI's integration fixes work.
project_fit_en: AOC, Discovery Lab integration validation and Trust Engine — external-state and webhook acknowledgment testing.
project_fit_bg: AOC, Discovery Lab integration validation и Trust Engine — тестване на external state и webhook acknowledgment.
build_vs_buy_en: A runnable sandbox may avoid building one-off mocks for supported APIs.
build_vs_buy_bg: Готов sandbox може да спести изграждането на еднократни mocks за поддържаните API-та.
why_it_matters_en: It tests whether an integration changed external state and completed its webhook lifecycle, separating an internal green test from authoritative acknowledgment.
why_it_matters_bg: Тества дали интеграцията е променила external state и е завършила webhook lifecycle-а, отделяйки вътрешен green test от authoritative acknowledgment.
cheapest_test_en: Run one harmless sandbox API and webhook flow with no real credentials or repository write; compare request, response, state change and receipt with the expected sequence.
cheapest_test_bg: Пусни един безвреден sandbox API и webhook flow без реални credentials или repository write; сравни request, response, state change и receipt с очакваната последователност.
risk_overlap_en: A vendor sandbox is not production ground truth, MCP adds a trust surface, and vendor receipts must not be treated as primary evidence outside the sandbox.
risk_overlap_bg: Vendor sandbox не е production ground truth, MCP добавя trust surface, а vendor receipts не трябва да се приемат за първично доказателство извън sandbox-а.
verdict_bg: Само kill test с един workflow.
